title: Interesting the static versus dynamic debate was always a fun cultural tension to watch between @mozilla foundation and @mozilla Corporation. MoFo alw
summary: Interesting the static versus dynamic debate was always a fun cultural tension to watch between @mozilla foundation and @mozilla Corporation. MoFo always wanted the latest and greatest in dynamic sites for public facing pages and MoCo was always like, "You know we can just do that in 63 lines of HTML."
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Interesting the static versus dynamic debate was always a fun cultural tension to watch between @mozilla foundation and @mozilla Corporation. MoFo always wanted the latest and greatest in dynamic sites for public facing pages and MoCo was always like, "You know we can just do that in 63 lines of HTML."
